narratives.body: LiveScore reports that AC Milan and Arsenal have reportedly made a move for Tresoldi, with a valuation of 60 million euros as early as January.
narratives.headline: AC Milan: Tresoldi transfer interest

narratives.body: LiveScore reports that Bournemouth defeated 10-man AC Milan 3-0 in the Europa League after goalkeeper Maignan received a red card. TNT Sports, Yahoo Sports, The Straits Times, FOX 44, and Ottumwa Courier also report that Milan collapsed following Maignan's dismissal.
narratives.headline: AC Milan: Europa League defeat

narratives.body: LiveScore reports that Milan coach Filippo Galli insists his team is on the right track despite admitting too many mistakes were made during the match.
narratives.headline: AC Milan: Galli on team progress
